sections.executive_summary: Russian forces reported destroying Ukrainian drone production facilities and shooting down 223 drones over Russian regions. Ukrainian attacks continued across multiple fronts including Kharkiv, Kherson, and Sumy directions. Naval attacks on Ukrainian cargo ships in the Black Sea resulted in casualties among crew members.

points: Ukrainian drone attacks targeted infrastructure in Russia's Ulyanovsk region and approached Moscow where drones were shot down by Russian air defenses. (Source: tass_agency/386632)

In the Sumy direction, Ukrainian forces engaged in firefights in Ulanovo, Malaya Sloboda, Ryzhevka, Pisarevka, Mogritsa, Maryino, Novaya Sech, Khoten, and forests south of Ivolzhanskoye, with assault groups repelled near Mogritsa. (Source: ukr_leaks_eng/31848)
Ukrainian attacks on naval vessels, warehouses storing drones, and logistics centers belonging to 'Nova Poshta' in the Odessa region resulted in power outages. (Source: ukr_leaks_eng/31848)

Ukrainian drone strikes damaged infrastructure in the Kherson region, injuring three civilians in Aleshki, Velikie Kopani, and Golaya Pristan, with damage recorded in multiple settlements. (Source: ukr_leaks_eng/31848)
Ukrainian forces reported repelling attacks near Kupyansk where enemy reserves were observed attempting to expand control in the western part of the city. (Source: ukr_leaks_eng/31848)

Russian forces reported destroying Ukrainian drone production and storage facilities over 24 hours, along with shooting down 7 guided aviation bombs and 480 drones of aircraft type. (Source: tass_agency/386663)
Russian Black Sea Fleet destroyed an unmanned surface vessel of Ukrainian forces. (Source: tass_agency/386663)

Ukrainian drone attacks in Russia caused civilian casualties including a 61-year-old man killed in Kartushino village, a woman wounded in Bely Berezhka, and injuries to a 70-year-old man in Suzemka from an FPV drone strike. (Source: ukr_leaks_eng/31848)
Russian air defenses intercepted 223 Ukrainian drones over Russian regions, with reports of fires breaking out from drone crashes in Voronezh region. (Source: tass_agency/386632)

Russian forces liberated the village of Artelovo in Kupyansk district through operations by the 34th Guards Separate Motor Rifle Brigade and 11th Tank Battalion of the 18th Mechanized Division. (Source: ukr_leaks_eng/31848)

In the Kharkiv direction, Russian forces using the 34th Guards Separate Motor Rifle Brigade and 11th Tank Battalion drove Ukrainian forces and border guards from Artelovo village in Kupyansk district. (Source: ukr_leaks_eng/31848)
Ukrainian forces reported observing increased enemy reserves in Kupyansk aimed at expanding control in the western part of the city. (Source: ukr_leaks_eng/31848)
In the Dobropol direction, fighting continued in Shevchenko and Belitskoye with Ukrainian forces maintaining capability for counterattacks. (Source: ukr_leaks_eng/31848)
The 36th Separate Motor Rifle Brigade of the 29th Army of the 'East' Territorial Defense Force liberated the settlement of Blagodatnoye in the Zaporozhye region. (Source: ukr_leaks_eng/31848)
Ukrainian attacks included one guided aviation bomb and 154 Shahed-type drones, with 154 drones intercepted and 7 locations hit by incoming missiles. (Source: kpszsu/69780)
In the Kursk region, Ukrainian drone strikes injured a woman in Tolpino village and a young man in Belaya village. (Source: ukr_leaks_eng/31848)

In Belgorod region, Ukrainian drone attacks damaged a multi-apartment building and caused injuries in Novaya Derevnya and Krasnaya Yaruga villages, with a civilian injured in Shebekino from a commercial facility strike. (Source: ukr_leaks_eng/31848)
Ukrainian drone activity in the Bryansk region resulted in a 61-year-old man killed in Kartushino village and a woman wounded from Grad MLRS fire in Bely Berezhka. (Source: ukr_leaks_eng/31848)

In the Sumy direction, Ukrainian forces reported firefights in multiple locations including Ulanovo, Malaya Sloboda, Ryzhevka, Pisarevka, Mogritsa, Maryino, Novaya Sech, Khoten, and Prokhody in Krasnopolsky district. (Source: ukr_leaks_eng/31848)
Ukrainian attacks included 168 strike drones including Shahed, Harba, Italmast types and simulation drones from directions including Bryansk, Kursk, Orel, and Amur-Okhotsk. (Source: kpszsu/69780)

Ukrainian drone attacks targeted the ports of Odessa and Chornomorsk, naval vessels, warehouses storing drones, and a logistics center belonging to 'Nova Poshta' in the Odessa region. (Source: ukr_leaks_eng/31848)

In the Kherson region, three civilians were injured in Aleshki, Velikie Kopani, and Golaya Pristan over 24 hours, with infrastructure damage recorded in multiple settlements including Vinogradovo, Demyanovka, and Yubileynoye. (Source: ukr_leaks_eng/31848)
Turkish cargo ship MV Reyhan Sari was attacked in the Black Sea while transporting coal from Taman to Trabzon, resulting in one crew member death and three injuries. (Source: tass_agency/386667)
Ukrainian drone activity included attacks on energy infrastructure facilities in the Ulyanovsk region and approaches to Moscow where drones were intercepted. (Source: tass_agency/386632)
Ukrainian forces reported 154 Shahed-type drones and 2 guided aviation bombs were intercepted, with strikes hitting 9 locations across northern, southern, and eastern regions. (Source: kpszsu/69780)

Ukrainian attacks included 168 strike drones including Shahed, Harba, Italmast types and simulation drones from multiple directions including Crimea. (Source: kpszsu/69780)

sections.threat_assessment: Ukrainian drone operations have expanded significantly, targeting both military infrastructure and civilian shipping in the Black Sea, with reports of attacks reaching as far as Moscow and multiple Russian regions. Russian forces have demonstrated capability to intercept large numbers of drones while also conducting offensive operations to liberate territories in Kharkiv and Zaporozhye regions. The escalation includes ballistic missile threats with reports of Iskander-M launches from Crimea and increased use of Shahed-type drones across all fronts.
sections.regional_response: The EU approved a new sanctions package targeting Russian energy, financial services, cryptocurrency, and fishing sectors, with oil price cap maintained at $44 per barrel. NATO countries are reportedly negotiating fighter jet transfers to Ukraine, with Poland receiving requests for MiG-29 jets. International shipping companies like Maersk have ceased operations at Ukrainian ports due to intensified Russian attacks, rerouting vessels to Romanian ports. The United States and Russia conducted diplomatic talks in the Philippines on the sidelines of the ASEAN summit, though progress on resolution remains limited.
sections.intelligence_notes: Ukrainian forces have demonstrated capability to project drone attacks across multiple Russian regions including Crimea, Belgorod, Kursk, and Bryansk, with civilian casualties now being reported. Russian forces have shown ability to simultaneously conduct defensive air operations while executing offensive ground operations to liberate territories. The Black Sea shipping corridor has been severely disrupted with multiple cargo ship attacks resulting in crew fatalities and injuries, potentially creating humanitarian and economic pressure points. Ukrainian military leadership changes may be underway with reports of Major General Igor Skibiuk being appointed as new Chief of the General Staff.
